summary: Native conversation views load complete clipped tool output and display fetched images inline without storing conversation data.

replay.detail: Explicit UI reads use the existing owner-native content chunk route; no claims are replayed or projections rebuilt.

schema.detail: No database schema, migrations or generated client wire fields change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or fleet coordination rules change.

compatibility.detail: Clients reuse conversation-blocks.v1 continuation refs and conversation-content-chunk responses. Continuation byte sizes describe the original owner value rather than its clipped display preview.

downtime.detail: No coordinated outage or API interruption is required.

manual.detail: No configuration change is required. Full output and image loading are explicit conversation-view actions.

recovery.detail: Expanded JSON, image bytes and inline rendering data remain in memory only; no new stored state or rollback procedure is introduced.
